findings.description: Two-commit submodule flow + codexu submodule-pointer bump omitted from the plan; without the pointer bump codexu never consumes the guard.
findings.resolution: Added Implementation Strategy step 4, In-Scope bullet, Risk bullet, ship-step note under story decomposition, and a dedicated acceptance criterion.

findings.description: Validator behavior underspecified for a `policy` that is present but not a plain object (null, [], "OFF", number) — codex deserializes policy as a struct, so these also abort its parse.
findings.resolution: Strengthened the validation rule to flag non-object policy as a violation; added an acceptance criterion and a risk bullet.

findings.description: Ordering: the submodule pointer bump must follow the toolkit commits; the plan stopped too early.
findings.resolution: Covered by Implementation Strategy step 4 and the ship-step note.

findings.description: Need an explicit acceptance criterion for the submodule commit/pointer contract.
findings.resolution: Added the two-commit-contract acceptance criterion (no unrelated parent changes staged).

findings.description: Acceptance criteria require catching an out-of-set installation value, but fixtures/tests only covered authentication.
findings.resolution: Added tools/fixtures/marketplace-policy-invalid-installation.json, an acceptance criterion, and a US-002 test case.

findings.description: ai-developer-toolkit/tools/AGENTS.md applies to new files under tools/ and should be read before editing.
findings.resolution: Added a risk bullet; verified tools/AGENTS.md is a developer-guide pointer file that does not block the plain-Node .mjs approach.

findings.description: Add an explicit acceptance criterion for present-but-invalid policy shape (non-object).
Malformed JSON, non-string policy values, and the missing-`name` plugins[<index>] fallback were only described in prose, not verifiable acceptance criteria.
findings.resolution: Added explicit acceptance criteria for malformed-JSON distinct failure, non-string value rejection, and the missing-name index fallback.

findings.description: The policy-free pass criterion only named .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; the plan must tolerate both policy-free indexes.
findings.resolution: Added an acceptance criterion exercising .github/plugin/marketplace.json as well.
